input.encoding: [n] where n is the square matrix dimension

output.meaning: row-major sum of the final lower-triangle factor elements after the PolyBench Cholesky kernel

source_bound.description: The pinned launcher uses the default LARGE_DATASET (N=2000). This bounded profile accepts 1<=n<=64. The binary64 initializer sets A0[i][j]=((-j % n)/n)+1 for j<=i using C signed remainder, zeroes the upper triangle, resets the diagonal to one, computes B=A0*A0^T with source-order t,r,s loops, and copies B into A. The source-order lower Cholesky loops then update off-diagonal entries, divide by earlier diagonal values, and square-root each diagonal. The source dumps the lower triangle; the suite returns its row-major sum.
